channel.title: Talking Pictures
channel.desc: As Kenneth Branagh prepares to unveil the latest version of `Death on the Nile', Celia Imrie looks at how the classic murder mysteries of the great Agatha Christie have been treated by film-makers over the years. Christie was the queen of crime on the page, but here we discover why that wasn't always the case on the big screen.
